crossRefs.note: He will not strive, nor shout; neither will anyone hear his voice in the streets.
The Son of Man has come eating and drinking, and you say, ‘Behold, a gluttonous man, and a drunkard; a friend of tax…
A wife is bound by law for as long as her husband lives; but if the husband is dead, she is free to be married to…
Whether therefore you eat, or drink, or whatever you do, do all to the glory of God.
Whatever you do, in word or in deed, do all in the name of the Lord Jesus, giving thanks to God the Father, through him.
Behold, I stand at the door and knock. If anyone hears my voice and opens the door, then I will come in to him, and…
He who receives you receives me, and he who receives me receives him who sent me.
“The King will answer them, ‘Most certainly I tell you, because you did it to one of the least of these my brothers…
“Then he will answer them, saying, ‘Most certainly I tell you, because you didn’t do it to one of the least of these…
Let marriage be held in honor among all, and let the bed be undefiled; but God will judge the sexually immoral and…

parallels.note: and sent out his servants to call those who were invited to the wedding feast, but they would not come.
Again he sent out other servants, saying, ‘Tell those who are invited, “Behold, I have prepared my dinner. My cattle…
“Then he said to his servants, ‘The wedding is ready, but those who were invited weren’t worthy.
Go therefore to the intersections of the highways, and as many as you may find, invite to the wedding feast.’

people.name: Jesus
people.line: The Son of God and Savior of the world.

translations.web: Jesus also was invited, with his disciples, to the wedding.
translations.bsb: and Jesus and His disciples had also been invited to the wedding.
translations.kjv: And both Jesus was called, and his disciples, to the marriage.
translations.asv: and Jesus also was bidden, and his disciples, to the marriage.
